data.name: Legendary Hierophant
data.description: (Supreme) Once per day, You can request a minor miracle. This request must be in line with the options for miracle that don't cost powdered diamond. As usual for a miracle, the deity or other being the spirit worships can choose whether or not to grant the request at its whim.
